answer.held_back_by: Probably nothing much, I ended as DPM, one step short of PM, so maybe the unseen CEP capped me. My STAND kept sliding even when I was honest, so I think visibility mattered more than good work.
answer.ending_fair_why: I got to DPM with full integrity and the card was calm about it. But I never found out why I stopped short of the top, so it felt a bit flat, not unfair.
answer.chase_next: The top succession ending. I'd play more for visibility and less for honesty, to see if I can get the top job instead of being the runner-up.
answer.play_again_why: 45 years of tapping is a lot and some years felt samey. Maybe later, if a friend gets a different ending.

tone_breaks.note: The pay mismatch was never explained, so it felt like a bug, not a joke or a point. I'm confused whether it was intended.

answer.title_fit_why: Minister Salary sounds like the game is about money but pay barely mattered to my choices. Confirmed & Substantive sounds more like a civil service term I don't get. I'd have called it something about the climb or the quiet years.
